description: Shadow Priest-style ranged caster - builds Insanity with Horrorbolt/Darkwither/Gaze, spends on Wrath of the Black Empire and an empowered Obliteration Beam above 60 Insanity.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Darkwither, Obliteration Beam, Eldritch Devastation, Whispers of C'thun/Greater confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: nearly every spell GENERATES Insanity (not spends) - it's a hover-near-the-top loop rewarding Corrupting Whispers procs and an Insanity-threshold Obliteration Beam upgrade, not a spend-to-zero rotation.

nodes.name: Shadow Focus
nodes.description: Increases spell damage and spell haste rating from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Corruption - Level 15 Passive. Spell damage + spell haste rating from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Terror
nodes.description: Increases Horrorbolt and Wrath of the Black Empire damage by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Lightbreaker
nodes.description: Increases spell critical strike damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Writhing Mass
nodes.description: Reduces Shadow damage taken by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Feeding Darkness
nodes.description: Increases Corruption spell range and critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Horrorbolt Volley
nodes.description: After 3 Horrorbolt casts, your next Horrorbolt transforms into Horrorbolt Volley, hitting nearby enemies too.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'After 3 Horrorbolts, transforms into Horrorbolt Volley.'

nodes.name: Occultism
nodes.description: Increases Wrath of the Black Empire critical strike chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Voidborn Affliction
nodes.description: Your periodic damage effects benefit from Haste.

nodes.name: Darkwither
nodes.description: Learn Darkwither, a Shadow DoT that reduces the target's periodic healing taken, stacking.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 18, Generates 10 Insanity, '190 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Each instance of damage reduces their periodic healing taken by 5%, stacking up to 4 times.'

nodes.name: Obliteration Beam
nodes.description: Learn Obliteration Beam, dealing Shadow damage to your target and nearby enemies. Empowered above 60 Insanity.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 22, Generates 10 Insanity, '181 Shadow damage to an enemy and all nearby enemies. While above 60 Insanity, deals 20% more damage.' Corruption's real AoE spender/generator.

nodes.name: Dark Revelation
nodes.description: Periodic and direct damage has a chance to reset Gaze of C'Thun's cooldown and generate Insanity.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 40 Passive. Periodic/direct damage chance to reset Gaze of C'Thun + generate 5 Insanity.' Keeps Gaze available as a free-cast filler alongside Horrorbolt.

nodes.name: Glimpse of Madness
nodes.description: Reduces Obliteration Beam's cooldown and applies Madness (a group damage-taken debuff) to all enemies struck.

nodes.name: Eldritch Devastation
nodes.description: Learn Eldritch Devastation, a channeled chain of Shadow damage over time that hits nearby enemies for reduced damage per target struck.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, 'Channel upon an enemy, chaining to nearby enemies, dealing 120 Shadow damage over 4 sec, dealing less damage with each enemy struck.'

nodes.name: Corrupting Whispers
nodes.description: Dealing damage has a chance to grant Corrupting Whispers, a stacking Magic-damage proc.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Corruption's core Insanity-height reward: 'Damage dealt chance to grant Corrupting Whispers.' Nearly every spell feeds Insanity, and staying high keeps this proccing.

nodes.name: Ancient Curse
nodes.description: Learn Ancient Curse, a Shadow curse dealing damage and increasing the target's Shadow damage taken from you, with extra damage on expiry.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Generates 20 Insanity. Curse: Shadow damage + boosts target's Shadow damage taken from you; extra damage at expiry.' The spec's biggest single burst of Insanity.

nodes.name: Embrace the Void
nodes.description: Reaching 60 Insanity grants a flat bonus to Magic damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Above 60 Insanity, the Corruption tree's Embrace the Void adds a flat damage buff.' NOTE per the handoff doc, this is deliberately NOT a cheat-death - Corruption's own Embrace the Void is a damage buff; the defensive cheat-death version of the same name lives in the shared class kit as a separate talent.

nodes.name: Visions
nodes.description: Learn Visions, a party-wide spell haste buff that also increases your Shadow damage.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid spell haste buff (no stacking with similar); boosts your Shadow damage.'

nodes.name: Unrelenting Void
nodes.description: Periodic and channeled damage increases the target's damage taken from you, stacking.

nodes.name: Terror of the Old Gods
nodes.description: Your next Horrorbolt becomes instant and hits additional enemies for a duration.

nodes.name: Psychic Suppression
nodes.description: Learn Psychic Suppression, launching an enemy airborne with a stun and repeating Shadow damage. Target takes more spell damage while channeled.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Corruption's hard control signature (retail Psychic Horror analog): 'Airborne stun + repeating Shadow damage; target takes more spell damage while channeled.'

nodes.name: Swift Blasts
nodes.description: Reduces the cast time of your Shadow bolt spells by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Enslave
nodes.description: Learn Enslave, a Polymorph-style crowd control on an enemy that also removes harmful magic. Damage may break it.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Polymorph-style CC on an enemy; removes harmful magic. Damage may break it.'

nodes.name: Mind Rot
nodes.description: Periodic and channeled damage has a chance to curse the target with Mind Rot.

nodes.name: Summon: Faceless Servant
nodes.description: Learn Summon: Faceless Servant, a minion that buffs nearby party and raid critical strike chance.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Summons a minion buffing nearby party/raid crit chance.'

nodes.name: Shatter Void Rune
nodes.description: Consume a Void Rune to deal AoE Shadow damage and knock enemies back.
